test.query: SELECT timeSeriesRemoveTag( [('__name__', 'metric'), ('namespace', toString(number % 100)), ('pod', toString(number % 500000))], '__name__') FROM numbers(2000000) SETTINGS max_threads = 1, max_block_size = 500000 FORMAT Null

SELECT timeSeriesRemoveAllTagsExcept( [('shared', 'value'), ('unique', toString(if(number % 2 = 0, 0, 16383)))], ['shared']) FROM numbers(4096000) SETTINGS max_threads = 1, max_block_size = 4096 FORMAT Null
